summary: A full-screen overlay used for onboarding or feature-announcement flows.
description: Spotlight is a plain exported object (export const Spotlight = {...}), not a class or custom element, that opens ASRouter/onboarding 'spotlight' messages as an HTML dialog (chrome://browser/content/spotlight.html) rendered either tab-modal or window-modal, via the browser's tab dialog box or gDialogBox.

attributes.name: message.content.modal
attributes.description: "tab" opens the dialog tab-modal via gBrowser's tab dialog box; any other value (or omitted) opens it window-modal via gDialogBox.

attributes.name: message.content.metrics
attributes.description: "block" suppresses IMPRESSION/DISMISS telemetry dispatch and CFR action dispatch for this message.

attributes.name: message.content.write_in_microsurvey
attributes.description: When true, added to the telemetry event_context for user-event telemetry.

attributes.name: message.trigger.id
attributes.description: When "lastWindowClose", replaces any already-open dialog and aborts other tab dialogs on the selected browser so this modal takes priority before the window closes.

methods.name: showSpotlightDialog
methods.description: async showSpotlightDialog(browser, message, dispatch = defaultDispatch): opens the dialog for the given message; returns a Promise<boolean> resolving once the dialog is closed (false if it couldn't be opened).

methods.name: close
methods.description: close(window?): closes the open dialog if no window is given, or if the given window owns it.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Getter: whether a spotlight dialog is currently open.

methods.name: sendUserEventTelemetry
methods.description: sendUserEventTelemetry(event, message, dispatch): dispatches a SPOTLIGHT_TELEMETRY action for IMPRESSION/DISMISS events (skipped when message.content.metrics === "block").

methods.name: defaultDispatch
methods.description: defaultDispatch(message): default dispatch handler, forwards SPOTLIGHT_TELEMETRY messages to AboutWelcomeTelemetry.
